task: Core #1186 F6-U03g: reconstruct historical 0046 customer-baseline on isolated PostgreSQL17 and prove full transaction guard acceptance

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Treat positive fixture as a proof-boundary test: genuine historical 47 SQL files, fail closed on incomplete provider model and no hosted access; never fabricate a full guard PASS.

acceptanceCriteria: Helper includes exactly 47 historical SQL sources 0001–0046 by version and filename order, excludes all 0047–0058 and detects changed source digests.
CI launches an isolated PostgreSQL17 service with no Supabase secrets and executes actual SQL, not a static synthetic 177-table imitation.
After actual 0046 replay, generate and compare public/private table/function/policy counts and full catalog fingerprint; mismatch must remain a correctly labeled blocker, not a false pass.
An optional exact unchanged F6-U03f positive test, if possible, must retain all guard checks, table locks and snapshot/provider conditions; if blocked, provide precise failing stage.
Runner forbids unknown external connection env/targets and never calls or relaxes hosted reset/59-file proof.
Exact-head canonical Plan Before Code, Quality Tests, TypeScript, Production Build, Completion Truth, Lifecycle and isolated fixture job are verified for the supported scope.
invariants: Source selection uses only immutable 0001–0046 existing reviewed file bytes and includes both distinct 0026 files.
Every SQL execution is restricted to a PostgreSQL17 service created in GitHub Actions for the run, using controlled local network/role/database.
No 0047–0058 migration or Office Pro/grant read-write operation occurs on any hosted project.
Positive full-guard proof cannot be reported on a skipped, mocked, partial, normalized or source-only check.
F6-U03b source candidate still contains an unconditional exception before any DROP SCHEMA.
forbiddenStates: Execution of a migration using a URL or credentials supplied from a hosted Supabase project.
Schema replay reports success despite a skipped or failed migration file.
An exact catalog fingerprint mismatch is silently ignored or replaced with a synthetic pass.
More than 47 historical SQL files are included or the two 0026 files are collapsed.
Local PostgreSQL17 result is promoted to hosted Alap/Pro RLS or Fresh Install READY.

failureModes: Metadata reports 0046 parity while tables were manually stubbed rather than created from canonical SQL.
SQL errors continue in psql and leave partially applied historical tables committed.
Ambient PGHOSTADDR, PGSERVICE or URL redirects a destructive local replay to cloud.
Raw schema hash depends on Postgres role OIDs/provider extensions and cannot be reproduced locally.
Default false-green CI when postgres service fails health/startup.
Fixture's simplified auth.users silently diverges from managed Auth and cross-schema policies.
Incorrect 0046 file-count selection drops one duplicate-version migration.
Local full guard holds locks but has no protected host external application or provider state.
edgeCases: Historical 0026 prefix maps to exactly two different migrations.
Seed file intentionally contains zero customer rows; neutral catalog rows originate from migrations.
Existing 0046 schema base creates 175 public tables and two private tables, 344 functions, 126 policies.
Supabase has six managed event triggers not supplied in vanilla PostgreSQL.
PostgreSQL pg_policy.polroles contains OIDs which may differ between hosted and fixture.
An unexpected migration needs extension or role not available in stock image.
Host project reference and TLS cannot be established from current_database()='postgres'.
No file path escapes customer-baseline/migrations directory.

specialistReviews.finding: Any CI fixture execution of SQL must fail before cloud connection redirection.
specialistReviews.resolution: Hardwired Docker PG17 host, controlled env, no cloud credentials and connection identity assertion.

specialistReviews.finding: Historical schema parity must come from unmodified 0046 migrations and be atomic.
specialistReviews.resolution: 47 source paths and checksum pinned, psql error-stop one transaction and read-only catalog comparison.

specialistReviews.finding: Provider-dependent raw schema fingerprint can be a reproducibility blocker without proving a customer defect.
specialistReviews.resolution: Distinct historical replay, exact fingerprint and full guarded positive verdicts; do not claim READY if any mismatch.

specialistReviews.finding: Source-only and fixture pass must not become parallel completion authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Existing CI Completion Truth/Lifecycle and immutable F6-U03f guard remain canonical.

challenge.scenario: Selection of 46 files from 0046 numerical label drops second 0026 migration.
challenge.finding: Historical names include 47 distinct SQL sources.
challenge.resolution: Deterministic sorted filename subset with exact 47 count and both 0026 asserted.

challenge.scenario: Runner claims positive test from one-table synthetic schema.
challenge.finding: Cannot assert 4621 catalog definitions or real RLS.
challenge.resolution: Require actual snapshot 0001 and all remaining migration files, reject synthetic DDL.

challenge.scenario: Vanilla Postgres lacks auth.uid/auth.users and managed roles.
challenge.finding: Migration replay will fail on FK/function dependencies.
challenge.resolution: Create minimal fixture-only provider shims and label their behavior nonauthoritative.

challenge.scenario: Fixture SQL silently connects to a hosted Supabase service via inherited PGHOSTADDR.
challenge.finding: Generated SQL can drop or modify real remote schema.
challenge.resolution: Use local explicit connection args and minimal process env; runner validates Docker service endpoint/DB identity.

challenge.scenario: Fixture schema catalog hash differs due to role OIDs or server extensions.
challenge.finding: Raw source-to-environment parity may not be portable.
challenge.resolution: Report mismatch verbatim, do not rewrite expected hash or mark full-guard PASS.

challenge.scenario: One migration fails but later files continue and green evidence is emitted.
challenge.finding: Incomplete schema would invalidate all counts.
challenge.resolution: Single transaction with ON_ERROR_STOP and verify COMMIT only on success.

challenge.scenario: A local historical baseline PASS is reported as 59-file Fresh Install or live Alap/Pro proof.
challenge.finding: Local source/hosted provider constraints are distinct.
challenge.resolution: Explicit scope flags and separate blocked readiness statuses.

challenge.scenario: Provider managed event watchers or grants are replicated incorrectly.
challenge.finding: Unsafe to infer actual Auth/PostgREST responses.
challenge.resolution: Classify event trigger/role shims as isolated and require hosted provider checks later.

proofPlan: Canonical Development Guard PASS with 20 Known Failures and Plan Before Code on 47-file scoped plan.
Static negative unit tests for exact sorted 0046 source selection, two 0026 files and no later migration inclusion.
GitHub Actions ephemeral PostgreSQL17 fixture with hardcoded local DB/role and provider shim setup.
Atomic replay 47 migrations and Auth bootstrap + seed; record first SQL failure and stop; no fake parity.
Read local public/private schema table/function/policy counts and compare to actual historic 0046 observed counts and 4621 definition fingerprint.
If exact parity, try full unchanged F6-U03f transaction guard without schema deletion and verify success or explicit blocker; do not bypass missing provider dependencies.
Standard exact-head CI, TypeScript, Lifecycle; keep real hosted Fresh Install and Office Alap/Pro blocked.
operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Historical 0046 proof left 175 public and 2 private application tables with exact 4621-object catalog fingerprint, but F6-U03f only proved mismatch rejection on a one-table fixture. No positive actual 0046 recreation or full guard acceptance has been shown. Prove or narrowly identify blockers using exact immutable ordered 0046 files in a PostgreSQL17 CI service without a hosted connection or relaxing the F6-U03f guard.
observableOutcomes: Source-controlled helper deterministically selects all 47 ordered customer-baseline SQL files 0001–0046 inclusive and checks migration filename continuity, final 0046 and no 0047–0058 leakage.

One isolated PostgreSQL17 Docker service reconstructs the historical 0046 application schema from real SQL, with minimal explicitly documented Auth/Storage/provider stand-ins, not mocked application tables.

Fixture reports observed tables/functions/policies/schema-catalog fingerprint and any blockers separately. An exact existing source guard may be reported as POSITIVE only if it actually passes without weakened requirements; mismatches must be explicitly FAILED or BLOCKED.
No automatic hosted project writes, active project changes, cross-tenant proof claims, original 59-file migration application or disabling of abort-before-DROP.
Report independent local reproduction result with immutable GH head provenance; standard CI/Completion Truth/Lifecycle verified separately.
unresolvedRisks: Vanilla PostgreSQL17 cannot reproduce all Supabase platform-maintained Auth/Storage schemas, roles, pg extensions, event-trigger source MD5s or PostgreSQL role OIDs needed for exact 4621 catalog hash.
Historical baseline source 0001 contains large generated schema snapshot; role/provider stubs could be incomplete and must fail transparently.
Exact 0046 schema objects in a local service are necessary but not sufficient for provider quiescence, TLS project identity and 59-file hosted replay.
Prior F6-U03f guard may use nonportable pg_policy role OIDs in catalog fingerprint; any normalization requires separate review, not unannounced weakening.

in: Implement deterministic 47-file historical 0046 source enumerator and SHA256 manifest.
Add local-only PostgreSQL17 CI service and a narrowly scoped fixture Auth, roles, extensions and Storage bootstrap with no Supabase DB credentials.
Replay historical source chain in one transaction using psql ON_ERROR_STOP=1, assert actual DB relation/function/RLS counts and source schema fingerprint where reproducible.
Generate separate reported statuses for historical-schema parity and unchanged full F6-U03f guard acceptance; no fake green readiness on mismatch.
Add unit tests for strict subset, forbidden hosted selectors, immutable source and proof-scoped verdicts, and document prerequisites/limitations.
out: No hosted Supabase DROP, replay, grant or data mutation and no project-status changes.
No changes to scripts/shoperation-f6-u03f-target-transaction-guard.mjs or disabling the F6-U03b abort-before-DROP.
No claiming that local provider stand-ins, Auth users or PostgREST events are genuine hosted behavior.
No Builder, Template Factory, alternative Control Plane, platform migration or Live Office Alap/Pro RLS signoff.

notes: F6-U03g scoped to an actual 0046 source replay attempt inside isolated PostgreSQL17 (47 source SQL files). Real baseline historical proof supplied by manifest at previous SHA, not newly asserted. Development Guard canonical PASS risk 4/5, 20 Known Failures; specialist review findings are engineering adversarial models, not human third-party approvals. On any provider mismatch, report BLOCKED rather than marking full positive acceptance.
